assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the provided completed Chinese painted palace gate. Keep the architecture, color, ornament, complete roof, full pillars, stone bases and entire landing exactly intact. Remove ALL of the brown/ochre/black gradient backdrop and ALL background between the columns and beneath the eaves: those open spaces must become genuinely transparent alpha, showing whatever scene is behind the gate. The only opaque pixels should belong to the painted architecture or the small natural ink-wash stone grounding. No brown vignette, smoke, sky, paper rectangle or artificial backdrop may remain. Preserve fine painted edges and delicate gold details without halos. Center the entire unchanged architectural subject with generous empty transparent padding on every side; no new object, no text. This is a reusable cutout layer for a 2.5D handscroll, not a poster on a brown background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one reusable TRANSPARENT painting asset for a Chinese gongbi blue-green peony handscroll: a long, extremely delicate horizontal bridge of pale ivory and a hint of sage-grey ink mist. Only three or four connected wisps of airy cloud wash, with subtle natural brush granulation, irregular tapered contours and feather-soft semi-transparent edges. Very low contrast, mostly empty transparent space; the mist should be lighter and thinner than a typical cloud bank, almost a breath through unpainted silk. Wide landscape composition, whole wisps fully contained with generous transparent extension on all sides. No scenery, mountains, buildings, figures, peonies, birds, text, gold outline, glow, smoke columns, harsh blur or solid white rectangle. Actual RGBA transparency including between the wisps, no painted paper background. Intended to connect adjacent 2.5D scenes without obscuring their subjects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a reusable TRANSPARENT long horizontal distant-mountain wash for a traditional Chinese Qinglü gongbi peony handscroll. A single coherent chain of small low distant blue-green and sage-grey mountain silhouettes, extremely pale and quiet, with a little warm mineral-ochre accent and subtle ink granulation. Keep the forms like distant traditional ink painting, not rocky realistic terrain or sharp black clipart. Natural irregular complete contours, much lower contrast than a main foreground mountain; both ends taper away into transparent mist and the lower wash dissolves gradually into genuine alpha. Whole mountain chain fully contained in a wide panoramic canvas with substantial empty transparent safety margins above, below and at both ends. No foreground objects, architecture, figures, birds, text, sun, moon, gold lines, rectangle paper or full painted sky. This is a sparse far-background continuity layer, leaving the handscroll breathing room.
